name: Bug Collector
description: You run into a bug collector. He offers to share with you one of the bugs he has caught today.

name: Dragons Nest
description: You stumble upon a dragon's hoard. Take something before the dragon comes back!

name: Rainbow Berry
description: As you wade through the forest, you stumble upon a berry bush. In the bush is a peculiar rainbow berry.

name: Baby Basilisk
description: In the middle of a forest, you come across a crying baby basilisk monster. It seems it has gotten lost from its parents.

name: Meteor Crash
description: You see a meteor fly through the sky and then crash nearby. You rush over to see the meteor with a glowing gem embed in it.

options.flavor: Take some meteor debris and sell it

name: Pond Fairy
description: As you stroll through the forest, a blue fairy monster emerges from a nearby pond. The fairy says it will grant you a wish.

name: Dragon Tamer
description: You run into a traveling dragon tamer. He says he has too many dragons to take care of and offers you to adopt one.

options.flavor: Adopt the one with the big horn
Adopt the one with the crown

name: Dryad Statue
description: You explore deep into the woods and find a statue with a glowing gem embedded in its head.

options.reward: Give a monster Grass typing, Gain a Dryadell

name: Genius Inventor
description: You encounter a genius inventor. He asks if you want to test any of his new inventions.

options.reward: Give a monster Electric typing and +5 Shock

name: Professor Encounter
description: You run into a monster professor who's out doing research. He asks if there is anything you need help with?

name: Endless Boss Prep
description: You've finally made it this far. You might need one of these for the final battle

name: Second Chance
description: A mysterious trainer approaches. She says, "Don't give up now. You have potential. Take this."

options.flavor: Accept a life and a trinket
options.reward: Get a Super Rare trinket gift

options.flavor: Accept a life and a monster
options.reward: Gain a random level 2 Super Rare monster

options.flavor: Accept a life and a charm
